visual.description: Primary white background used for modals, overlays, and page surface.
Near-black used for all body text, nav links, and UI labels.
Pure black used for headings and high-emphasis text including cookie policy title.
Warm greige/stone tone dominating the hero background image behind the model.
The nav area appears to use the same light/transparent state in both scroll positions — near-black for filled button states.
Off-white warm surface tone visible in the upper navigation band.
Near-black fill used for primary CTA buttons (Agree, filled variants).
White fill used for outlined/secondary button variants and modal surface.
Bright cobalt blue used as focus/accessibility border on skip-to-content button.
Near-black used for button borders and UI dividers.
Near-black text color used in the top utility nav row (United States, Contact Us, Services).
Near-black used for primary navigation links (High Jewelry, Jewelry, Watches, etc.).
Nav background in scrolled state — same warm light surface, no visible change in these screenshots.
Nav text in scrolled state remains near-black.
